shared_zone_findings: All 20 selected blue outlines are completely inside their map crops, with translucent fill and legible numbered selection badges.
Underlying native map imagery is present in every capture; no blank selected-map load is visible.
The north compass is visible at upper right and the drag/pinch/rotate instruction is readable at the bottom; neither obscures the selected outline.
Some neighbouring badges and native symbols are naturally cut off by the viewport; the selected zones are not clipped.
Edge-zone views include flat peripheral map background beyond detailed city imagery; selected outlines remain visible and framed.

reported_replacement_guide_comparison.interpretation: Root-reported byte identity supports carrying forward the same bounded six-image guide findings. This receipt does not approve head 7132bcf0 or its complete CI result.

limits: The directly reviewed files are from first head 82f710dd6fc3a585a48e5daf3104fad28e6e765f; this is not final replacement-head CI approval.
Replacement-head map artifact and relevant runtime hash comparison remain root responsibilities before carrying these map findings forward.
The twenty zone images are static 343×478 phone map-canvas crops, not whole-page screenshots. Controls and layout outside those crops are not certified.
The four clothing/beauty guide images capture first viewports only. Lower-page guide sections are outside this review.
The two Mission 008 images show the expanded card rather than the full surrounding page.
Static screenshots do not establish pinch, drag, rotation, compass-reset or link behaviour; no interaction or automated tests were run in this review.
Phone zone screenshots do not establish desktop map behaviour.

Thick selection strokes and underlying badges conceal portions of original native boundaries. This review supplements the prior source/geometry review and does not independently establish precise boundary registration.
Selection outlines do not establish physical walls, walking routes, spawn coordinates or encounter class. WZ17 displayed connectivity must not be treated as proof of walkability.
